correctness.rationale: For any centered iid entry noise with common variance delta, the covariance transfer C->E0 C E0^T+delta tr(C)I is exact. Nilpotent E0 has rank-one singular representation 2K u v^T. Its positive 2x2 moment transfer has Perron root delta+sqrt(delta²+4K²delta), giving iff threshold delta<1/(4K²+2). Orthogonal rank-one Q leaves a scalar product with independent second-moment factor K²cos²(2theta)+delta. The first factor is positive for every nonzero error. The setup probe has nondegenerate Gaussian output for every nonzero fixed probe, so unstable angular arcs have positive probability, establishing unconditional mean-square divergence. The standalone verifier confirms independent symbolic/rational identities and sampled numerical moments; the infinite assertions have analytic proofs.

value.rationale: The 2026 analog-digital correction guarantees samplewise one-application energy improvement but does not establish iterative convergence. The theorem produces an exact sharp dual stability phase diagram (raw noise threshold and corrected angular threshold), a rational separation witness, and a mathematically sharp finite-probe robustness failure caused by rare misaligned learned spaces. This identifies a concrete missing stability safeguard and supplies an exact benchmark for fixed-point variants, without claiming failure of FGMRES or practical hardware frequency.
